correctness.rationale: Each signed character is an exact sum over all permutations. For support on k vertices, n!/k! completions establish scaling; disjoint components factor after normalization. Reversal forces odd-component zeros. A proven last-element subset recurrence computes the only six connected small motifs and two-wedge disconnected motif. Graph edge-count classification exhausts supports of size at most four; exact labeled counts yield 3*C(n,3), 3*C(n,4), 125*C(n,5), 90*C(n,6). The direct permutation enumeration for n=4,5,6 and separate subset DP in verify.py passed. This is an all-order structural proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The degree-four band is the first even band beyond pair interactions, where connected local ranking comparisons can cancel without global reversal (triangle with pendant edge). The theorem completely resolves which low-degree Walsh signals survive XOR convolution by all total orders, with exact attenuation magnitudes and a closed all-order rank polynomial. This is a natural finite-degree interpolation question in ranking models, with motifs interpretable as small comparison patterns; it is not an arbitrary numeral slice or a plain recomputation of a standard table.
